size.description: Its size now: a resize changes it once applied

cpuMicros.description: CPU time used since it started

rxBytes.description: Traffic in since it was created

txBytes.description: Traffic out since it was created

steal.description: Share of CPU time the hypervisor gave elsewhere: a virtual machine on a busy host

hostCpu.description: Machines: CPU used outside partitions, averaged over about an hour (PLAN §29)

cpuMulti.description: Every core compressing, MB/s in all

diskWrite.description: Writing to the partitions' disk, flushed, MB/s

diskSync.description: A small write made durable (fsync), milliseconds

rotational.description: A spinning disk, says the kernel

streams.description: Open terminals: session -> highest input seq applied. Only sent while one is open

streamInput.description: New terminal input per session, after the cursors in `streams`

resetCommands.description: The agent's cursor is ahead of this server's commands (state from an earlier registration): forget received commands and the stored desired state

desired.description: Only when the version is newer than appliedVersion

sealed.description: The DesiredSpec as JSON, sealed to this agent

close.description: Stream sessions nobody is watching any more: stop them

maxBytesPerSec.description: Output above this rate is dropped and marked as truncated

containers.description: Live samples only; history points omit it

peers.description: server -> reachable (a WireGuard handshake in the last 3 minutes)

sealed.description: lib/agents/sealing.ts format; the agent opens it

sshKey.description: Deploy key for generic Git over SSH

ref.description: Commit SHA, or a branch the builder resolves

dockerfile.description: Rendered template; otherwise dockerfilePath inside the repo

buildEnv.description: Build-stage variables, mounted as the `huruf-env` BuildKit secret (shell `export` lines)

gitImage.description: Image that runs git, so hosts need no git

push.description: Registry modes: push the built image here

drainMs.description: Wait after removing a container from routing, before stopping it

name.description: Container name prefix and status key, unique on the server

ingress.description: Served on the ingress listener to requests whose X-Huruf-Project is this project (custom domains, PLAN §14)

routed.description: Receives traffic (public port and .internal DNS) once healthy

path.description: HTTP GET on the port; any status below 500 counts as up. Without a path, a TCP connect

command.description: A shell command run inside the container (compose `healthcheck`); healthy once it passes

s3.description: Mount a bucket folder through the rclone volume plugin instead of a local volume

provider.description: rclone's s3-provider, e.g. AWS, Cloudflare, Minio, Other

pull.description: Pull the image from this registry when it isn't local

reserve.description: Reserved per replica; with limits, the base for autoscale targets and the capacity room

base.description: Per-replica limit, else reservation: 100% for usage percents

cpuPercent.description: Target average CPU per replica, as a percent of `base.cpu`

memPercent.description: Target average memory per replica, as a percent of `base.memMb`

keepImages.description: Images of kept releases (local and registry tags), for rollbacks; other images we built are removed

mesh.description: The private network (PLAN §8.2); absent means this server isn't in it

address.description: This server's mesh address with prefix, e.g. 10.209.0.3/16

project.description: Project rules average its replicas here; server rules use the host

threshold.description: Percent for cpu/memory/disk (above fires); MiB of memory room for room (below fires)

forwards.description: A machine's forwards into its partitions: public ports and each partition's mesh port

registry.description: Run the tenant's built-in registry here (primary server)

password.description: Hashed on the server with the edge proxy's `caddy hash-password` (bcrypt)

ingress.description: Reverse tunnels from this server's ingress listener to the control plane (PLAN §14); absent means none

user.description: This server's id, its tunnel login

tunnelPort.description: Port the tunnel opens on each control plane instance

servers.description: frps addresses (host:port), one per control plane instance

ca.description: PEM certificate frps' TLS is checked against

peers.description: server -> reachable (a WireGuard handshake in the last 3 minutes)

day.description: Host usage over the last 24 h

url.description: The binary for this server's architecture

isolated.description: A rental (PLAN §28): no reaching the machine, other partitions, the metadata endpoint, mail ports or private ranges

url.description: The control plane, as the agent inside reaches it

peer.description: The other machine: the source lets it in, the target reaches its tunnel

from.description: host:port; empty when only the relay reaches the source
